bargeIn.title: Interruption Style
bargeIn.description: Adjust how easily you can speak over the AI.

learningGoals.title: Learning goals
learningGoals.description: Save a focus for Practice and Study modes and optionally track your weekly effort.
learningGoals.focusTooLong: Keep your learning focus to 300 characters or fewer.
learningGoals.targetDescription: Optional. Leave blank to turn off the weekly target. Answers in all modes count.
learningGoals.targetInvalid: Enter a whole-number weekly target greater than zero.

audio.title: Microphone & Audio Check
audio.description: Choose the devices ImmiGO uses and test them before your session.
audio.deviceHint: Connect a Bluetooth headset before opening this screen; new devices appear automatically.
audio.permissionDescription: We need microphone permission to show device names and test your audio.
audio.permissionDenied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, then refresh.
audio.unsupported: Audio device selection is not supported in this browser.
audio.micWorking: We can hear you. Your microphone is working.
audio.micSilent: No sound detected. Check the selected microphone or try another device.
audio.micError: We couldn't start the microphone test. Check your browser permission and try again.
audio.micBusy: End your voice session before testing the microphone.
audio.speakerUnsupported: Choosing an output device isn't supported by this browser. Your system default speaker will be used.
audio.speakerPlayed: If you heard the chime, your speaker is working.
audio.speakerFailed: We couldn't play the test sound. Try the system default speaker.
audio.secureContext: Audio testing requires a secure (HTTPS) connection.
